offering_description.value: Lamb Weston makes frozen french fries, other frozen potato products, and frozen appetizers for restaurant chains, foodservice operators, and grocery retailers. It processes and freezes potatoes at its plants and sells the finished products directly and through distributors.

primary_products.value: frozen french fries; hash browns and formed potato products; frozen sweet potato products; frozen appetizers

customer_segment.value: B2B: quick-service restaurant chains, independent restaurants, foodservice distributors, institutional dining operators, and grocery retailers; B2C: grocery shoppers buying frozen potatoes and appetizers for home use

end_markets.value: quick-service restaurants; full-service restaurants; institutional foodservice; retail frozen foods

revenue_model.value: product sales: frozen fries, other potato products, and appetizers in foodservice and retail packs

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes grower-supplied potatoes into frozen foods for restaurant chains, foodservice distributors, and grocery retailers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: frozen fries, other frozen potato products, and appetizers sold through shared foodservice and retail channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: major restaurant chains, foodservice accounts, and grocery retailers; distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors serving independent restaurants and institutional kitchens; third-party retail: grocery stores and other food retailers selling packaged frozen products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety and labeling requirements, comparable rules abroad, and plant wastewater and environmental standards
